answer: Deposits are visible in haven, and terrace reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 46 aliases, and each one needs its own funded copper account. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 228 aliases cost 204 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
